note: English language pack. The word lists are heuristics; they were not validated against real channel data. An entry ending in '*' is a stem match (the word starts with it); otherwise the match is exact.

hook_words.note: Band of a spoken hook that fits inside about ten seconds at ~150 words per minute; taken from the source pack's heuristic, not validated.

messages.lang_unknown: language unclear: pass --lang tr or --lang en
messages.heuristic: heuristic check, not a view prediction

fixes.specificity: swap one adjective for a number, a name or a date
fixes.address: speak to the viewer in the first six words (you, your)
fixes.stakes: say what it costs the viewer to keep doing it the current way
fixes.curiosity: cut the half of the sentence that answers itself
fixes.length: read it out loud and stop where your breath runs out

messages.no_pattern: no pattern matched; if it reads like a summary, rewrite the opening

title_issues.over_limit: title is {n} characters; YouTube's limit is 100
title_issues.search_cut: title is {n} characters; past 60 it may be cut in search (observation, not official)
title_issues.mobile_cut: title is {n} characters; past 40 it may be cut in the mobile feed (observation, not official)
title_issues.caps: {n} words in ALL CAPS; past 2 it reads as spam
title_issues.thumb_words: thumbnail text is {n} words; past 3 it is unreadable at feed size
title_issues.thumb_partial: thumbnail text shares words with the title: {w}

messages.chapters_invalid: chapter list is invalid; YouTube will not show it as chapters

chapter_problems.too_few: at least 3 timestamps are needed ({n} given)
chapter_problems.not_ascending: timestamps are not in ascending order: {t}
chapter_problems.duration_short: the video is shorter than the start of the last chapter: {t}

messages.draft_titles: titles are drafts; rewrite each one as the promise of that section
messages.no_cues: no timestamped lines found (expected .srt, .vtt or Whisper .json)
